### An Inconsolable Father
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/inconsolable-father
Passage: Genesis 37:34-35
Points:
- Jacob was shattered by the apparent death of his favored son and refused all comfort.
- The brothers attempted to hide their crime by presenting a blood-soaked coat, compounding sin with deception.
- Ironically, Jacob was tricked with a slaughtered goat just as he once deceived his own father Isaac.
- Unbeknownst to the grieving father, God was providentially working through tragedy to preserve life.
- God's ability to bring life from death in Joseph's story ultimately foreshadows the resurrection of Christ.
